body: Fans reportedly took the “Mac Miller Rd” sign so many times that it was changed to “M. Miller Rd” 😭🕊️❤️ The road in Vermont became a meaningful stop for fans, who made the trip to take photos and remember an artist whose music meant so much to them. What might look like an ordinary street sign to someone else was a little connection to Mac. According to a visitor who shared photos in 2021, the shortened name was meant to keep the sign from being stolen again. They also asked fellow fans to respect the spot and leave it for others to enjoy. 🙏 The road wasn’t originally named after the rapper, but that hasn’t stopped fans from finding meaning in it. A shared name was enough to turn an unexpected place into somewhere to pause, put on his music and remember him. Most Dope forever. ❤️ 📸: Getty Images

source_caption_text:
Fans reportedly took the “Mac Miller Rd” sign so many times that it was changed to “M. Miller Rd” 😭🕊️❤️

The road in Vermont became a meaningful stop for fans, who made the trip to take photos and remember an artist whose music meant so much to them. What might look like an ordinary street sign to someone else was a little connection to Mac.

According to a visitor who shared photos in 2021, the shortened name was meant to keep the sign from being stolen again. They also asked fellow fans to respect the spot and leave it for others to enjoy. 🙏

The road wasn’t originally named after the rapper, but that hasn’t stopped fans from finding meaning in it. A shared name was enough to turn an unexpected place into somewhere to pause, put on his music and remember him.

Most Dope forever. ❤️

📸: Getty Images
